title: LLM Use for Mental Health: Crowdsourcing Users’ Sentiment-based Perspectives and Values from Social Discussions

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing crowdsourced social media posts using an LLM-assisted extraction pipeline to compare disparate user sentiments, perceived risks, values, and interaction perspectives across different self-reported mental health conditions (e.g., ADHD, schizophrenia, depression, anxiety).

Quantifying user-reported concerns about general model bias by extracting and correlating mentions of the value 'Freedom from Bias' and the perspective 'Ethics' within social media discussions about LLM chatbots.
